notes.problem: Rounded boxes sitting on the pipe; no die pads, loom or grime.
notes.fix: Jaws wrapping the joint with die pads and hairline shadows, a loom, grime.

notes.problem: Clean rounded boxes, no die pads or loom, the pipe above a light column.
notes.fix: Jaw castings wrapping the joint with die inserts, a cable loom and grime, a mill scale pipe above with a specular line, tighter crop.

notes.problem: Gripper reads as stacked white boxes; no jaws visible; the pipe above is a blurred column.
notes.fix: Turn the camera about 30 degrees so the die-padded jaws wrap the tool joint in profile, run the pipe sharp out of the top, add the cable loom.

notes.problem: Stock office art and a starfield window, no contractor.
notes.fix: A rig control display of the floor camera, the lit floor in the window, the contractor's shoulder and vest.

notes.problem: Stock dashboards, speckled window, no operator.
notes.fix: A floor camera view on the screens, the lit floor and arm through the window, the operator's shoulder.

notes.problem: A stock control room with invented charts and an empty chair.
notes.fix: An over-the-shoulder contractor and one camera view of the floor on the screens.

notes.problem: Mannequin before a shed, stand base hidden.
notes.fix: The worker beside the stand's base in one pool.

notes.problem: Worker cut at the shins, stand base hidden, an unplanned shed.
notes.fix: Lower and pull back so the worker stands whole beside the stand's base; delete the shed.

notes.problem: Mannequin worker cut by the footer; shed, gate, stand and arm split the focus.
notes.fix: Remove the shed, stand the worker full height at the base of the stand, crop the arm out.

notes.problem: Stripes; the lowest joints under the footer.
notes.fix: All 20 joints and both beams above the footer; stronger casts.

notes.problem: Blinds at 432 px; the rack runs off the bottom.
notes.fix: All 20 joints and both beams between dek and footer, rotated a little, each casting a crescent.

notes.problem: The rack in plan reads as blinds; joints run off the bottom.
notes.fix: Fit all 20 joints above the footer and show their round ends.

notes.problem: Tread plates textured, not lit; grating a flat stripe; 'the rest' outside the safe zone.
notes.fix: A keyMask pool so the three tread plates are clearly brighter; move 'the rest' inside the margin.

notes.problem: Nine plates read as a flat pattern, both columns mid grey at thumb, and 'the rest' sits on floor plates.
notes.fix: Make the lit third the only bright object and say the rest happen elsewhere.

notes.problem: A floating stub; blank sign band.
notes.fix: The full stand out of the top edge; letter the band.

notes.problem: A stub over the slips, blank sign band, stray diagonal rail.
notes.fix: A three-joint stand rising out of the top, remove the diagonal, letter or drop the band.
The cover's paint; slip dies that cast.

notes.problem: The rig is a dot; strata uniform noise; hard seam.
notes.fix: A mast silhouette at scale, three or four distinct bands, feathered top edge.

notes.problem: Toy rig, dead band, tan bands.
notes.fix: Closer camera on the rig floor; frame 5's ember paint on the bands.
